supported_registration.not_reviewed_run_import: reviewed_run_import is for a complete reviewed-run principal artifact and is not appropriate for this detached pending retification

procedure: Use the same deployment TENDERPROOF_ARTIFACT_DIR and operational store as the target run; do not use the evidence directory as storage_path.
Read the preserved PDF, verify len=423600 and SHA256 exactly; reject before writing on any mismatch.

Construct Artifact with artifact_id, exact sha/byte_len, url_requested=url_final=the pending URL, content_type=application/pdf, and a valid preserved-acquisition timestamp. Call save_artifact_file; it atomically writes a hash-addressed basename and registers the blob.
Before registration, inspect the existing blob by artifact_id: same SHA/length is idempotent; any different SHA/length is a hard stop and must not be overwritten.
Reload with load_artifact_bytes and recheck bytes/hash/length. Only after this checkpoint send one prepare-preserved request bound to the exact run and pending manifest.

On prepare failure, stop and capture status/body; do not retry, approve, propose or apply. The registered blob may remain as preserved evidence; no catalogue/version/outbox/notification mutation is expected.
